story.overview:
As a user, I want suggested prompts that surface available skills and adapt to response content, so that I discover powerful capabilities like spreadsheet generation and file creation that I might not know exist.
This story extends the existing prompt factory (Story 7.1) with skill awareness, enabling prompts to: 1. Hint at available skills when loaded 2. Suggest skill-specific actions based on response content 3. Provide follow-up prompts after skill usage

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Given Orion has skills loaded (xlsx, pdf, summarize, etc.), When prompts are generated, Then at least one prompt hints at an available skill capability

Given a response mentions data or information that could be exported, When follow-up prompts are generated, Then prompts include skill-specific suggestions (e.g., "Create a spreadsheet", "Generate a PDF report")
Given a response includes analysis or research, When follow-up prompts are generated, Then prompts suggest relevant skill-based outputs (e.g., "Visualize this data", "Create a presentation")
Given the Skills API returns available skill IDs, When the prompt factory is called, Then skill metadata is used to generate relevant prompts
Given a user has already used a skill in the conversation, When prompts are generated, Then related skill follow-ups are suggested (e.g., after xlsx creation: "Add charts", "Create another sheet")
Given prompts are displayed, When the user views them, Then maximum 4 prompts are shown (Slack API limit preserved from 7.1)

dependencies.dependency: Story 7.1 - Dynamic Suggested Prompts (prompt factory foundation)
Story 6.4 - Skill Registry Service (provides skill metadata)

technical-notes.note: Use skillRegistry.getAllSkillIds() + getSkillMetadata() pattern - NOT getLoadedSkills(). Import type SkillRegistryEntry from src/skills/types.ts, not a custom SkillMetadata interface.
Developer tools to exclude from prompts: mcp-builder, skill-creator, webapp-testing, web-artifacts-builder, example
getSkillAwarePrompts() returns max 2 skill prompts to blend with context prompts. Final output always max 4 prompts (Slack API limit).

1. usedSkillInResponse (highest - show skill follow-ups) 2. lastResponseType (existing behavior) 3. responseContent + skills (content analysis) 4. availableSkills only (general hints) 5. Time-based/base prompts (lowest)

key-test-scenarios.scenario: Skill prompts included when skills available
Empty/undefined availableSkills produces standard prompts (backwards compatible)
SkillRegistryEntry used correctly with skill.name lookup
Skill follow-ups take priority over base prompts
All scenarios maintain max 4 prompt limit

relevant-sections.section: Skills are loaded at startup via initializeSkills(). Skill IDs stored in memory registry. Access via skillRegistry.getAllSkillIds() and skillRegistry.getSkillMetadata(id). Import from src/skills/index.ts

User-facing skills (show in prompts): xlsx, pdf, docx, summarize, d3js-visualization, algorithmic-art, frontend-design Developer tools (exclude): mcp-builder, skill-creator, webapp-testing, web-artifacts-builder, example
Location: src/slack/prompts/prompt-factory.ts Provides: Context-aware base prompts, time-based prompts, response-type follow-ups MAX_PROMPTS constant = 4 (Slack API limit)
Existing fields: channelType, userId, channelId, threadHistory, lastResponseType, errorCode, hourOfDay New fields to add: availableSkills, responseContent, usedSkillInResponse, usedSkillsInThread

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Always use .js extension - import { x } from './module.js'
kebab-case.ts for files, PascalCase for types/interfaces
Use SkillRegistryEntry from src/skills/types.ts, not custom types
Use *bold* not **bold** in any user-facing text

file-structure.file: New file with getSkillAwarePrompts, analyzeResponseForSkillPrompts, getSkillFollowUpPrompts
Unit tests for skill prompt functions
